init_collective_logger: initialize a CollectiveLogger singleton via init_logger and retrieve it with get_logger
config_logger_with_wandb: configure the logger with a DictConfig to enable wandb console and json logging backends
log_metrics_by_event: log a dictionary of metrics keyed by LogEvent type and optional step number
log_colored_console_messages: log info warning error debug or critical messages with color-coded LogEvent namespace prefixes
describe_numpy_array_stats: compute mean std min and max summary statistics for a numpy array of metrics
